strategies.name: Baseline: last week's demand, no battery
strategies.note: Buys the demand of the same block one week earlier and has no battery.

strategies.name: ML demand forecast, no battery
strategies.note: Buys the ML demand forecast and has no battery.

strategies.name: Naive forecasts + battery
strategies.note: Plans the battery with last week's demand and prices under the same tuned rules as the product.

strategies.name: Our product: ML forecasts + battery
strategies.note: Plans the battery hour by hour with the ML demand and price forecasts and the tuned bidding rules.

strategies.name: ML + battery, simple 4-hour block plan
strategies.note: Uses the same ML forecasts but plans the six 4-hour blocks with the default rules.

strategies.name: Perfect foresight, 4-hour block rules
strategies.note: Knows the real demand and prices in advance but must follow the same 4-hour block rules.

strategies.name: Perfect foresight, hourly, back to start level every day
strategies.note: Knows everything in advance and plans every hour, but returns to the start level every evening.

strategies.name: Perfect foresight, hourly (best possible)
strategies.note: Knows everything in advance and plans all hours of the period at once, the best result possible.
